name: Cottage Health Junior Volunteers
what_you_do: Volunteer at a Cottage Health hospital in the Santa Barbara area. You help patients, families, visitors and staff for about four hours a week.
who_can_apply: Junior volunteers can be as young as 14 if they are in high school. Santa Ynez Valley Cottage Hospital in Solvang takes junior volunteers only at 17 and older.
deadline_text: No application dates are posted. The page invites volunteers who can give four hours a week.
how_to_apply: Use the Volunteer at Cottage Health online application linked from the volunteer page, or call Volunteer Services at 805-569-7357 or email volunteering@sbch.org.
notes: Cottage Health runs Santa Barbara Cottage Hospital, Goleta Valley Cottage Hospital and Santa Ynez Valley Cottage Hospital. The pages do not list junior volunteer tasks or health checks, so ask Volunteer Services. The online application page did not finish loading when we checked, so it was not read.
